head: c2861d63
gate: HTTP/2 ConcurrentStream.startResponseWithBody mirrors the HTTP/3 combined response command
change: New additive API `ConcurrentStream.startResponseWithBody(options, data, fin)` plus a deadline form on the HTTP/2 continuous concurrent engine. The owner executes the response head and the first DATA contribution in one command, removing one wake/command round trip per buffered response. `startResponse`/`writeData` keep their existing semantics, and the HTTP/2 engine already suppresses bodies for HEAD/204/304 inside `startResponse`.

h3_reference.note: The same shape on HTTP/3 (c2861d63) measured 101.8 -> 59.2 us/request sequential and 53.2 -> 39.7 us/request at batch=8 in the netz harness.

h2_baseline_weft.note: weft still calls startResponse + writeData, so this is the pre-adoption baseline

notes: The H2 win is not yet measured because weft's handler has to adopt the new call; the HTTP/3 measurement of the identical shape is the reference. The new HTTP/2 test covers the ordinary GET path through the combined command.
